title: Recording: Beautiful Boys, Kiss Kiss Kiss, Hard Times Are Over, Yes I’m Your Angel, Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

An overdub session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 19 September 1980.

Ono worked on her lead vocals for five songs: ‘Beautiful Boys’, ‘Kiss Kiss Kiss’, ‘Hard Times Are Over’, ‘Yes, I’m Your Angel’, and ‘Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him’.

Page last updated: 18 May 2026
